Container.Name: MediaHub
Container.Overview: One web page and one login for Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, Bookarr, qBittorrent and SABnzbd, with an overview of everything, manual import, full settings, RSS and search.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the MediaHub web page.

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: Your login, app addresses, API keys and image cache. To keep your current settings, point this at the folder your old container used for /config.

Config.Name: Behind a tunnel or reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set to 1 if you reach MediaHub through Cloudflare Tunnel, nginx or similar.
